verdict.rationale: Cloudflare explicitly ships Workflows for durable execution plus Queues/cron integration and claims compute-only billing even for long agent workflows (cloudflare-docs-9, cloudflare-docs-15), but hands-on community feedback says the CPU-time limits (30s free/15min paid) make Workers unsuitable for long-running agent tasks, pushing some to self-host workers instead (cloudflare-comm-9).
